justification: Clear eyes. Jones stays under center — we named him QB1 and we don't chase Lawrence because the board whispered louder. Hampton and Dowdle earned the rock; Lloyd and Corum wait their turn even with a thin edge on paper. WR2 is locked with St. Brown from the early window. Puka and McLaurin stay out wide. Andrews over Goedert — trust the veteran who shows up. Same kick, same Chargers D. Belief over the spreadsheet.
